Как хранятся файлы · Compare These Texts: Your files & privacy · Compare These Texts
Сравнение и подготовка исправленного фай: Comparison and document editing happen in your browser.
Когда вы выбираете документ, сайт читает: When you select a document, the website reads it on your device. Document contents are not sent to a comparison server or an external AI service. You need an internet connection to load the website itself.
Приложение может сохранять текущую работ: The app can save your current work and edits in this browser so you can continue after reloading. Use the option to delete saved work, or clear this website’s data in your browser settings.
На общем компьютере удалите сохранённую: On a shared computer, delete saved work when you finish. Private browsing may prevent work from being saved.
Можно продолжить в расширении?: Can I continue in the extension?
Сайт и расширение хранят работы отдельно: The website and extension store work separately. To move between them, download your edited document and open it where you want to continue.
Файл — до 2 МБ. PDF должен содержать выд: Files can be up to 2 MB. PDFs must contain selectable text; scanned documents are not supported yet. Word documents display supported formatting, which may differ from Microsoft Word’s layout. Text comparison does not assess legal meaning.
При открытии сайта хостинг получает обыч: When you open the website, the hosting provider receives standard connection information, such as your IP address and the requested page. We do not add advertising trackers or use connection information to compare your documents.
